about: A scatter whose points also show a third measure as their area. Recharts scales the area, not the radius, so a point twice the value is twice the ink. Readers judge area roughly, so the tooltip writes the value.

accounts.about: Seats against weekly active seats, each account sized by its annual recurring revenue. Each series lists its points largest first, so the small ones render on top.
accounts.caption: Business accounts use fewer of their seats: weekly activity falls to 43% at 200 seats, against 58% or more on every Team account.
accounts.label: Weekly active seats by account size
accounts.title: Two series

features.about: One series of features: adoption across accounts against the rating users give, each feature sized by its weekly users. yDomain runs the rating axis from 1 to 5, the scale the rating uses.
features.caption: The best-rated feature, at 4.6, is adopted by only 29% of accounts.
features.label: Rating by adoption per feature
features.title: One series

largest.about: defaultIndex opens the tooltip at the largest account when the chart first renders. The tooltip writes the size's value beside the two axes' values.
largest.caption: The largest account, €216K a year, uses 66% of its 240 seats weekly.
largest.title: Tooltip

narrow.about: The accounts in a room 20rem wide, the column of a phone. The points keep their areas, so they crowd more than on a wide plot.
narrow.title: Narrow room

quiet.about: A chart without points renders the empty state in the plot's place, at the plot's ratio.
quiet.caption: Weekly active seats by account size.
quiet.title: Empty

replay.about: animate grows each point from its centre when the chart mounts, and Replay mounts the chart again. Under reduced motion recharts renders the points at once.
replay.title: Animation

title: Bubble chart
